title: C: Quick Sort
description: Implement the quicksort algorithm using the divide-and-conquer approach.

steps.title: Quick Sort Implementation
steps.description: Implement quicksort: `void quicksort(int arr[], int low, int high)` with Lomuto partitioning. Test with `{10, 7, 8, 9, 1, 5}`.
hints: Partition: choose last element as pivot.
Elements less than pivot go left, greater go right.
Recursively sort left and right partitions.
